boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Claremont Village corridors beside the Claremont Colleges.

cards.title: Folk Music Center
cards.subtitle: 220 N. Yale Ave. — Yale Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk Yale Avenue to browse the Folk Music Center, a named Village music destination listed at 220 N. Yale Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A Yale Avenue stop for a music-focused errand.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Folk Music Center under Music at 220 N. Yale Ave.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current store access before visiting.

cards.title: Claremont Lewis Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: 200 W. First St. — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to the Depot on First Street for the Claremont Lewis Museum of Art; the Village lists it among local art galleries.
cards.short_summary: A First Street art stop at the historic depot.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Claremont Lewis Museum of Art as an art gallery at 200 W. First St., Claremont Depot.
cards.access_notes: The Village student-offers page states admission is free for students; check museum visit details before going.

cards.title: Claremont Packing House
cards.subtitle: W. First Street — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Packing House stretch of First Street to combine several named shops, food businesses, studios, and entertainment listings in one stop.
cards.short_summary: A reused-citrus-packing building with clustered destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The official visitor site identifies the Claremont Packing House as a place to shop and dine in Claremont.
cards.access_notes: Individual tenants set their own access and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Claremont Forum Bookshop & Gallery
cards.subtitle: 544 W. First St. — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow First Street to the Packing House for the Claremont Forum Bookshop & Gallery, a named bookshop-and-gallery destination.
cards.short_summary: A First Street stop pairing books with gallery space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Claremont Forum Bookshop & Gallery at 544 W. First St. in the Packing House.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current access and any event details with the business.

cards.title: Stix Ride Shop
cards.subtitle: 456 W. First St. — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Make First Street your bike-gear corridor by stopping at Stix Ride Shop, listed by the Village at 456 W. First Street.
cards.short_summary: A named First Street destination for ride-related gear.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Stix Ride Shop at 456 W. First St.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases may be required for goods or services.

cards.title: Village Dance Arts
cards.subtitle: 111 Harvard Place — Harvard Place corridor
cards.notes: Turn onto Harvard Place for Village Dance Arts, a named local studio and workshop destination listed at 111 Harvard Place.
cards.short_summary: A Harvard Place destination for dance instruction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Village Dance Arts under Studios & Workshops at 111 Harvard Place.
cards.access_notes: Contact the studio for current class availability and enrollment requirements.

cards.title: JAX Bicycle Center
cards.subtitle: 217 W. First St. — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the First Street corridor for a bike-service or equipment errand at JAX Bicycle Center, listed at 217 W. First Street.
cards.short_summary: A named First Street bike-shop stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists JAX Bicycle Center at 217 W. First St.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases or service charges may apply.

cards.title: Claremont Chef's Academy
cards.subtitle: 514 W. First St. — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Packing House on First Street for Claremont Chef's Academy, a named studio-and-workshop listing for culinary classes.
cards.short_summary: A First Street destination for scheduled cooking classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Claremont Chef's Academy under Studios & Workshops at 514 W. First St. in the Packing House.
cards.access_notes: Classes require advance confirmation and may have fees.

cards.entity_name: Lost Levels Sports Card Shop & TCG
cards.title: Lost Levels Sports Card Shop & TCG
cards.subtitle: 530 W. First St. — First Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop in the Packing House on First Street for Lost Levels, the Village’s named entertainment listing for sports cards and TCGs.
cards.short_summary: A Packing House destination for trading-card interests.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Lost Levels Sports Card Shop & TCG under Entertainment at 530 W. First St. in the Packing House.
cards.access_notes: Retail purchases may be required for merchandise or events.

cards.title: Some Crust Bakery & Cafe
cards.subtitle: 119 Yale Ave. — Yale Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use Yale Avenue for a bakery-and-café stop at Some Crust, which the Village lists at 119 Yale Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A named Yale Avenue bakery and café destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Village lists Some Crust Bakery & Cafe at 119 Yale Ave. under Dining.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; confirm current service details with the café.
